description: Wrapping route_method in StoaHandler instead of porting all handlers to JmapBackend is the right call for this phase. A contributor might suggest 'just implement MailBackend properly' — that would require touching ~20 handler arms simultaneously with high regression risk. The adapter pattern preserves all handler behavior with a clear seam; the full backend migration becomes incremental work.
title: StoaHandler strangler-fig pattern cleanly isolates Dispatcher integration from handler logic
